'''Talana''' will be the [[Queen of Andor]] in the future seen by [[Aviendha]] inside the [[Glass columns]] ''[[ter'angreal]]'' in [[Rhuidean]]
==Activities==
Talana is [[Elayne]] and [[Rand]]'s granddaughter and queen of Andor about sixty years after the [[Last Battle]]. During Aviendha's visions of the future in the glass columns ter'angreal in Rhuidean, Aviendha sees Talana agree to join the war against the [[Seanchan]] when [[Oncala]] and [[Hehyal]] show her a plan the Seanchan has for assassinating her. As she is of Rand's line, she is likely to pull the other nations into the war, especially those in the [[Court of the Sun]] and the [[Pact of the Griffin]].
